title: D3K, wild throw to first; batter to 2nd, R1 to 3rd; a strikeout with no out

expect.note: K credited, no out recorded. The reach is deliberately **unenabled**: the ball got past her, which is what entitled her to run, and `bounceLocation` says so now that `swinging_strike_blocked` is gone (v0.46). That is why it derives a wild pitch. Link the reach to the wild throw instead and it would say she blocked it and reached on the error — no WP, no PB (§13.2 v0.44).  FielderTouch here references the pitch event as its ball reference (no BallInPlay exists on a D3K); engine must accept that.
